system.name: MAGNET
system.one_liner: Adapts decoder-only LLMs to also learn representations and infill missing spans, with an attention mask mixing causal and bidirectional attention.

content.variant_note: four sibling columns in one grammar, a capability checklist above a token-row attention sketch, the proposed model last
content.argues: Only MAGNET offers text generation, text infilling and representation learning together, by combining unidirectional and bidirectional attention.
content.subject: Four model types (LLM, Infilling LLM, Encoder LLM, MAGNET LLM) shown by supported capabilities and the attention between input x and output y.

summary: MAGNET adapts decoder-only LLMs so that they also learn representations and fill in missing text spans, using three self-supervised objectives and an attention mask that mixes causal and bidirectional attention. Figure 1 is a four-column teaser: LLM, Infilling LLM, Encoder LLM and MAGNET LLM. Each column lists three capabilities (text generation, text infilling, representation learning) with tick or cross emoji, unsupported ones greyed and struck through, above two rows of six token boxes joined by attention lines: dark lines for unidirectional attention, light grey for bidirectional. Only the last column, in red, has three ticks and mixes both line types. A bracket line along the top derives the three variants from the base LLM.
summary_zh: MAGNET 让只做生成的解码器大模型也能做表征学习和文本填充。图分四列：LLM、填充 LLM、编码器 LLM、MAGNET，各列用对勾叉号列出三种能力，词元行间深灰线为单向注意力、浅灰线为双向，只有 MAGNET 三项全有并混用两种线。
notes: The prior pass's model-anatomy kind is kept as secondary although the anatomy shown is only attention connectivity between two token rows. The swap of x3-x4 and x5-x6 under the infilling column is read from the reordered labels; the paper text given does not explain it.
